eu_covid.finding: EU-only premium is consistently negative across all years including COVID

eu_covid_sb.finding: EU SB rate dropped during COVID (17.1->16.2%) then rose post-COVID (19.9%)
eu_covid_sb.interpretation: COVID emergency procurement initially lowered SB rates (more competition for urgent goods), but the institutional erosion persisted, raising SB rates 2.8pp above pre-COVID levels by 2023
